caption: The drawing depicts multiple views and details of a brass floor-standing candle holder. The central object is a tall, slender pole with a round base supported by three curved legs, all rendered in yellowish brass tones with shading for form. Extending from the pole near the top are two curved arms, each ending in a candle socket, drawn in the same yellow brass color and shown holding unlit, pale yellow candles with slightly curved wicks. To the left, a close-up view provides a detailed look at one of the arms and its candle socket, emphasizing the curvatures, decorative motifs, and the way it attaches to the main pole. Below this, another detail shows the round, stepped brass base in close-up, illustrating its circular ridges and metallic sheen. On the right, a vertical segment of the pole and one of its legs are isolated to show individual construction details. The background is plain, and the image is framed by a dark line border. The artist’s name, “Y. Staluff,” appears in the bottom left corner.
title: Candlestand
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
